items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 16 at 3:00AM EST until November 21 at 4:00AM EST by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots and seas 4 to 7 feet
expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America, including Tampa Bay,
Charlotte Harbor and Pine Island Sound.


* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 4 AM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
